text: it shows up. but its not even covering me or anythiong. how do i give it depth
resolution: Fixed the reported 'pond doesn't cover me / has no depth': water was rendered as a thin 0.12m surface film floating at the surface level, so on flat ground it read as a faint blue sheet at chest height, not a body. Now water renders as a translucent VOLUME filling from the ground plane up to surfaceY (new shared waterBodyVolume helper, used by both render3d/WaterBody and the compiled bake pushWaterBodies), tucked 0.3m under the bed so the shoreline has no gap. Walking into it now surrounds you with water up to the surface — a Pond (1.5m) is wade/chest depth, a Lake (2.5m) goes over the player's head; depth is the surface level so a deeper preset = deeper water. Editor/test live now; /compiled needs the no-V8 loader rebuilt (shape-aware translucent render shipped earlier).
